experiment: real hand, static, manual ROI (no hand-recognition model)

recommended_hand.pose: palm facing the lens, fingers together pointing up, forearm vertical below the hand with the elbow resting on a support; arm stays below the hand (not behind it, not from the side)
recommended_hand.rule: fingertips >= 1 cm inside ROI top, maximize hand-face fraction in ROI (analysis/hand-height-scan.json); fixed before any capture or LOW/HIGH run

stable_frame_rule.window: running median of the current run (registered tapes); HOLD median (unregistered)

capture.tape: longest contiguous stable HOLD run; frames replayed in recorded order; looped only if the requested replay is longer, and flagged
capture.registration: virtual camera translation from the capture (register_hand.py); placement precision not required

live_guide.stable_rule: running median of current run, 1 cm (register_hand.stable_runs)

capture.hold_frames_note: 200 frames >= ~165 needed for one A->B replay (~5.3 s); 600-step tapes reuse frames cyclically (flagged looped)

background_limits.note: checked with no hand: ROI and nominal robot path corridor (+0.05 m) should be empty
